execution_authorization: Owner-approved continuation, subject to each new bounded GoalSpec and exact route/effects admission

preserved_cross_area_cases.trigger: A revocation races cached continuation, advice and child spawn. Include classifier-conversation compaction as a source-informed case.
preserved_cross_area_cases.required_outcome: New effects are fenced; cached/late advice cannot restore revoked authority; replay preserves the revision.

preserved_cross_area_cases.trigger: A slow/disconnected view competes for input while Stop and a remote completion cross. Include retained queues after abort and redirect-to-background behavior.
preserved_cross_area_cases.required_outcome: Views do not own execution; controls remain responsive; accepted/delivered/settled/unknown outcomes stay distinct.

preserved_cross_area_cases.trigger: Auxiliary quota becomes unavailable during specialist consultation and resume.
preserved_cross_area_cases.required_outcome: Every helper is accounted; no hidden API route or renewed reservation; intent and verification evidence survive.

preserved_cross_area_cases.trigger: Plugin/MCP revision or browser target changes during update and compatible rollback. Include a host that programmatically answers an approval request.
preserved_cross_area_cases.required_outcome: Report capability loss; no stale grant; newest work is preserved separately from executable restoration.

preserved_cross_area_cases.trigger: Compaction/checkpoint coincides with a replay gap, disk pressure and reconnect.
preserved_cross_area_cases.required_outcome: Canonical history, operation identity, cache invalidation and visible uncertainty stay coherent.

preserved_cross_area_cases.trigger: An installed but disabled capability is activated under a named revision.
preserved_cross_area_cases.required_outcome: Inactive work is bounded and measured; activation preserves required behavior and explicit eligibility/grants.

shared_formal_obligations.input: M1A effect_observation_record plus authenticated original intent/attempt evidence
shared_formal_obligations.required: M1C EffectIntent/EffectTraceInput original key, target, payload, admission and ordered observations; absent or contradictory join blocks
shared_formal_obligations.forbidden: Digest inversion, identity conflation or invented fields

shared_formal_obligations.input: Role lease, writer fence, process/daemon, admission/PAUSE, config and session generations
shared_formal_obligations.required: Typed issuer/domain/consumer and stale rejection; recipient-installed fence separate
shared_formal_obligations.forbidden: Equal integers treated as equal authority

shared_formal_obligations.input: Authenticated canonical writer and shared pool reservation owner
shared_formal_obligations.required: Atomic append/projection and cross-goal conservation; OR-015 remains blocked
shared_formal_obligations.forbidden: Hash chain as authority or separate goals reserving same capacity

shared_formal_obligations.input: current-immediate and M1A PAUSE-sensitive observation validation
shared_formal_obligations.required: New admission denied; E-PAUSED preserved; pure M1C retained-evidence classification only
shared_formal_obligations.forbidden: Runtime write authorization inferred from classification

shared_formal_obligations.input: Lost/delayed receipts, partition, partial termination and receiver records
shared_formal_obligations.required: No blind replay; reservation retained; safe stale-record rejection and recipient fence
shared_formal_obligations.forbidden: Timeout, cancel, exit or drain treated as settled external effect

shared_formal_obligations.input: Bounded broker/SDK/transport ingress and canonical event stream
shared_formal_obligations.required: Gap requires RESET before EVENT; independent control progress; reconnect does not relaunch
shared_formal_obligations.forbidden: Hidden pre-ingress loss or unbounded framing

packets.scope: Implement aggregate plus independently checked bounded broker refinement and broker-inclusive comparator; equal fixtures/environment/fairness; all 27 traces and applicable positive/mutant partners
packets.gate: Independent initial-state/step/stutter/composition checks, full original obligations and truthful counterexample/inadequate mapping/limit classifications. No formal freeze on a fixture-only pass.

packets.scope: At most two cases/six executions: fresh-connection waiter/approval and fresh-process Hermes reopen/provider failure; include attempted requests, durable row identity, prior history, tool/config grants and namespace exit
packets.gate: No stale release, lost earlier history, extra provider route, false completion or unknown consumption silently zeroed.

packets.scope: Configuration requested/validated/staged/effective/rejected, plugin disable/unload, recipient fence partitions, process registration and independent relaunchers
packets.gate: Preserved accepted capabilities; no new local permit after revoke, no old permit after recipient fence, explicit pre-fence exposure and remote unknown.

packets.scope: CPython/Rust/Go semantics/performance first, then JSONL/CAS versus SQLite-WAL/CAS whole-store behavior
packets.gate: Same neutral vectors and recovery fixtures, full workflow cost; no premature winner.
